title: 9.3 Collecting Data

icans: I can identify types of samples and tell whether a sample is biased.
I can identify the method of data collection.
I can recognize biased survey questions and rewrite them.

vocab: every member of the _____________ has an equal chance of being chosen
a rule is used, such as every 10th __________
the _____________ is divided into groups, and members are randomly chosen from each group
the _____________ is divided into groups, and all members of some randomly chosen groups are surveyed
only __________ who are easy to reach are chosen
a sample or question that overrepresents or __________________ part of the population

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Stratified: random members from _______________ group. Cluster: _______________ members of some groups.

blocks.stem:
Identify the type of sample.
a.  every 10th student who enters the gym
b.  all students in 3 randomly chosen homerooms
c.  20 randomly chosen students from each grade
d.  students who answer a poll on the school website
A town wants to know whether residents support building a new park. It surveys people at an existing park. Is the sample biased? Explain.

notes: Methods of collecting data: Experiment: apply a _______________. Observational study: _______________ without changing anything.
Biased questions: A biased question _______________ people toward an answer.

blocks.stem:
Identify the method of data collection.
a.  A researcher records how many cars run a red light at an intersection.
b.  A computer flips 1,000 virtual coins.
c.  Doctors give half of the patients a new drug.
d.  A questionnaire is mailed to customers.

Identify the type of sample.
a.  A coach randomly picks 2 players from each grade.
b.  A teacher asks the first 10 students who arrive.

tickets.stem: A store surveys every 5th customer. What type of sample is this?
A radio station asks listeners to call in with their opinions. What type of sample is this, and is it biased?
